message.content: {"decision":"accept","reason":"This arXiv paper presents a new method, HiSentinel, that trains lightweight sentinels to decide when and how to intervene in coding agents' actions before execution, improving task completion by up to 14%. It includes a new dataset (SWE-Intervene) with annotated software-engineering trajectories and shows consistent improvements across benchmarks and agent families, providing concrete evidence about improving coding agent reliability through pre-execution intervention. This is relevant for learners to understand emerging safeguards that can prevent error propagation in autonomous coding agents.","piece_ids":["01"],"strongest_claim":"HiSentinel's lightweight pre-execution intervention sentinels improve coding agent task completion by up to 14% while preventing error propagation and maintaining competitive token usage.","evidence_type":"data","perspective":"research","commercial_incentive":false}
